name: How long does it take to install kitchen task lighting?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install kitchen task lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen task lighting installation depends on the scope of the project. A straightforward installation of a few under-cabinet LED strips in an existing kitchen might take a few hours to a full day. More complex projects involving new electrical wiring, multiple fixture types, or installations in a kitchen undergoing a full remodel could take one to three days. We strive to complete projects efficiently while maintaining high quality and minimizing disruption to your home. We'll provide a clear timeline during the quoting phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies from a few hours for simple LED strips to 1-3 days for complex projects requiring new wiring or multiple fixture types.
